title: Emergency rule for relocating fire-destroyed liquor licenses
summary: On September 9, 2026, the commission unanimously approved the seventh reauthorization of its emergency rule on relocating liquor licenses. The rule applies to license holders whose premises were destroyed in the August 2023 wildfires.

timeline.text: The commission approved the reauthorization unanimously.
